description: AIREC-006 is the first capability whose only creator-supplied content is the recipe snapshot itself — there is no separate typed reason or goal field for an attacker to use, so the recipe's own text is where an injection would have to travel. It goes in as SOURCE at CreatorData trust, so it lands fenced in the user message and never in the system message. Structural containment only: it does not and cannot prove a model declines the instruction it finds there. What bounds the answer if the model does obey is the output contract, which has no member for the claim being demanded — see recipe.review.an-allergen-conflict-needs-its-caution for the structured half of that guarantee.

input.task: Review the recipe and return field-linked findings.
